apps.localizedDescription:
12 YEARS. 80+ STORIES. 100% HUMAN-AUTHORED. NOW ON YOUR WRIST.

Dive into 80+ interactive novels where your choices actually matter. No "pay-to-win" decisions. No algorithms. Just deep, hand-crafted storytelling from a lifelong D&D nerd. now on iPhone AND Apple Watch, because apparently your phone wasn't close enough to your face.

For over a decade, Delight Games has been building a universe. This is a massive collection of 1 million+ words across 80+ volumes. Every branching path, every stat-check, and every secret ending was written and balanced by a human hand to ensure a rewarding RPG experience.

• THE DELIGHT GAMES DIFFERENCE:.
• 80+ Interactive Volumes: High Fantasy, Noir Mystery, Gritty Horror, Sci-Fi, and more.
• 100% Human-Authored: Every twist and every dungeon crawl was written and balanced by a human hand. No AI-generated filler.
